content.title: About
content.content: Iced Coffee, pre-lightened and pre-sweetened (5183) is a ready‑to‑drink cold coffee that has been lightly roasted and sweetened. It offers a smooth roasted aroma, gentle sweetness, and a refreshing texture, perfect for quick consumption without adding extra sugar or milk.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cold coffee retains most of the antioxidants found in hot brewed coffee.
Pre‑lightening reduces bitterness, giving the beverage a milder flavor.
Sweetening is usually done with natural sweeteners such as sucrose or fructose.
While often served over ice, it can also be used as a base for cocktails and desserts.
The product has a long shelf life thanks to its airtight packaging.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Boosts alertness
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving concentration and reaction time.

items.title: Supports metabolism
items.content: Caffeine may increase metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Improves mood
items.content: Caffeine promotes the release of dopamine and serotonin, which can enhance mood.

items.title: Contributes to hydration
items.content: Although coffee has a mild diuretic effect, in moderate amounts it adds to daily fluid intake.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine consumption.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Sweetened coffee can raise blood glucose levels, especially for people with diabetes.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee’s acidity may irritate the stomach in those with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to coffee components can occur.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the iced coffee straight from the bottle, add ice, milk, cream, or flavored syrups to taste. It can also serve as a base for frappés, smoothies, dessert sauces, and marinades.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 2–3 days.
